Do you guys actually notice a difference between sativa and indica?

i find it really depends on your source and your understanding of the strain your smoking. its very hard to find pure sativas and pure indicas anymore. everything is a dominant hybrid nowadays. The best ive had of both worlds was a euphoric mind tripping numb body with an indica, and a super energetic dance party music loving sexbomb sativa. everything thats not one of those two to me feels like a hybrid

For me, the difference is having insane cravings for munchies or not - Sativa I'm not craving them, Indica I am. Apart from that, the only other difference might be a foggier head high with Indica...more of a "zone out" than a head high, really. With Sativa, I'm in a good mood and can think, I just don't zone out or get hungry. I've certainly started selecting one vs the other depending on what I'm looking for. For example, when I want to meditate I would smoke Indica...if I wanted to watch controversial Youtube videos and lightly ponder stuff like the NWO and the US's secret space fleet (Solar Warden and Gary McKinnon, worth a search), I'd smoke Sativa.

Also, the reason you might not be seeing much of a difference between your strains is because they might not be that genetically different. A recent study (if I come across it I'll post it) showed that Afghani kush and another strain that was supposedly the opposite type were almost genetically identical. Growing your own weed and dealing with reputable seed suppliers is probably the best way the average person can be sure that what they're smoking is actually Indica/Sativa, and even then there might be some grey area.
